terra.problem: The passage names the sources of the metals, but it does not say they came from far and wide.
The passage says skilled workers fashioned the clothes, but does not say they were tailored to fit.
The passage calls them skilled workers, but does not say they were sewing.
The verse does not mention the forest, but that does not establish that nothing in it is part of the scene.
Being put to shame does not necessarily establish that the goldsmith feels embarrassed.
The claim that a blessing has to come from somebody is not stated in the passage.
Saying the LORD holds Israel dear attributes a feeling to Him that this passage does not state.
